title: ChildDigitalTwin
description: The system's cumulative understanding of the child (ADR-013). A PROJECTION over the event log — never a raw pocket (ADR-004). Raw views reference Reducer output; insight entries carry confidence + provenance and decay without reinforcement. Observation first, interpretation second: no personality labels, no conclusions without evidence chain.

capabilities.description: Read-through reference to the derived capability view (ADR-004), annotated with trend. Numbers here are projections, never independently stored truth.

motivation.description: What currently moves the child (insight layer).

learning_pattern.description: How the child tends to learn (insight layer): e.g. 'retries verbal tasks, gives up physical ones'.

relationship.description: Partner relationship summary; the full partner state lives in partner-state.schema.json.

story_progress.description: Where the shared story currently stands (zh).

family_goals.description: Parent-stated goals; translated into adventures via the interest bridge, never imposed directly.

growth_priorities.description: Capability ids the family/system currently prioritizes.

constraints.description: Hard limits (health, schedule, parental rules). Safety > child autonomy > growth goals > parent expectations.

supporting_event_ids.description: Provenance is mandatory (ADR-012/013): no bare claims.

stale.description: Set when Event History contradicts this entry. History wins.
